say:1:1310134001:0.text: We have finally dealt with them...

say:2:1310134002:0.text: Magister, your prowess alongside your familiars and your companions is indeed formidable.
say:2:1310134002:0.male: Magister, your prowess alongside your familiars and your companions is indeed formidable.
say:2:1310134002:0.female: Magister, your prowess alongside your familiars and your companions is indeed formidable.

say:3:1310134003:0.text: I appreciate your assistance. I should not have doubted your capabilities. I apologize again for my earlier demeanor.
say:3:1310134003:0.source_cn: 感谢诸位的援助，我不该怀疑你们的能力，请允许我为我之前...

say:4:1310134004:0.text: Oh, don't be like that! You were just looking out for us.
say:4:1310134004:0.source_cn: 哎呀，不必这样，你也是为了我们的安全考虑……

say:5:1310134005:0.text: My duty was to maintain safety in the vicinity of Cedartown, preventing the undead from disrupting the festival.
say:5:1310134005:0.source_cn: 我本应负责雪松镇周边的安全，以应对可能会对祭典造成破坏...

say:6:1310134006:0.text: The events of this evening... are a result of my negligence. The people in that cabin...
say:6:1310134006:0.source_cn: 唉，今晚的事是我疏忽了……那间屋子里的朋友们……

say:7:1310134007:0.text: Don't worry! They're all safe. We sent them back to rest.
say:7:1310134007:0.source_cn: 别担心，他们都还好。我们让他们去你的小屋里休息了。

say:8:1310134008:0.text: Thanks to all of you. Let us return and check on them.
say:8:1310134008:0.source_cn: 多亏诸位援手，我们先回去看看，希望那几位朋友没有受到大伤害。
